3
Haman pam Yudafoɔ tiri so
1Nsɛm yi akyiri no, Ɔhene Akas-weros yɛɛ Agagni Haman a ɔyɛ Hamedata ba no kɛseɛ, na ɔmaa no so, na ɔmaa n’adwa so senee mmapɔmma a wɔne no wɔ hɔ no nyinaa deɛ. 2Na ɔhene nkoa a wɔte ɔhene ponkɛseɛ mu nyinaa koto sɔree Haman, ɛfiri sɛ saa na na ɔhene ahyɛ ama no. Na Mordekai deɛ, wankoto na wansɔre no. 3Ɛnna ɔhene nkoa a wɔwɔ ɔhene ponkɛseɛ mu no bisaa Mordekai sɛ: Adɛn nti na wo deɛ, woto ɔhene mmara no? 4Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no saa daa na ɔntie wɔn no, wɔkɔka kyerɛɛ Haman, sɛ wɔrehwɛ sɛ Mordekai nsɛm no bɛgyina anaa. Na waka akyerɛ wɔn sɛ ɔyɛ Yudani.
5Na Haman hunuu sɛ Mordekai nkoto nsɔre no no, abufuo hyɛɛ Haman ma. 6Nanso wampɛ sɛ ɔde ne nsa bɛka Mordekai nko ara, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔakyerɛ no deɛ Mordekai fire, na Haman hwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔsɛe Yudafoɔ a wɔwɔ Akas-weros ahennie nyinaa mu a wɔyɛ Mordekai nkurɔfoɔ no nyinaa.
7 # Est 9.24 Bosome a ɛdi kan a ɛne bosome Nisan#3.7 NISAN: Ɛte sɛ Ɔbɛnem mpaemu ne Oforisuo mpaemu abosome. no mu, Ɔhene Akas-weros afe a ɛtɔ so dummienu mu no, wɔtwee Pur, a ɛne ntonto, Haman anim, da biara da, na ɛfiri bosome no so ara kɔsii bosome a ɛtɔ so dummienu a ɛne bosome Adar.#3.7 ADAR: Ɛte sɛ Ogyefuo mpaemu ne Ɔbɛnem mpaemu abosome. 8Na Haman ka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Akas-weros sɛ: Ɔman baako bi wɔ hɔ a wɔabɔ apete, na wɔate wɔn ho afiri amanaman mu, w’ahennie nsase nyinaa soɔ, na ɛsono wɔn mmara ne aman nyinaa deɛ, na ɔhene mmara no, wɔnni so, na ɛmfata ɔhene sɛ ɔbɛma wɔn kwan. 9Na sɛ ɔhene pɛ a, ma wɔntwerɛ sɛ wɔnsɛe wɔn, na mɛkari dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ mpemdu mahyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ ɔhene adwuma no nsa, sɛ wɔmfa ngu ɔhene akoradeɛ mu. 10#Est 8.2 Ɛnna ɔhene no yii ne pɛtea firii ne nsa de maa Agagni Haman a ɔyɛ Hamedata ba, Yudafoɔ tamfo no. 11Na ɔhene no ka kyerɛɛ Haman sɛ: Dwetɛ no, wɔde ama wo, na ɔman no nso, yɛ wɔn sɛdeɛ wo pɛ.
12 # Est 1.22 Ɛnna wɔfrɛfrɛɛ ɔhene no atwerɛfoɔ bosome a ɛdi kan, da ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa soɔ, na wɔtwerɛɛ no sɛdeɛ Haman hyɛeɛ nyinaa de kɔmaa ɔhene no amradofoɔ ne amantam no mmaako mmaako so ahwɛfoɔ ne aman no nyinaa so mmapɔmma, asase biara sɛdeɛ ne ntwerɛeɛ teɛ, ne ɔman biara sɛdeɛ ne kasa teɛ. Wɔde Ɔhene Akas-weros din na ɛtwerɛeɛ, na wɔde ɔhene no pɛtea sɔɔ ano. 13Na wɔde nwoma no somasomaa awɛmfoɔ maa wɔde kɔɔ ɔhene nsase nyinaa so, sɛ wɔnsɛe na wɔnkunkum na wɔnnwerɛ Yudafoɔ no nyinaa mfiri mmeranteɛ so nkɔsi nkɔkoraa so, mmɔfra ne mmaa nso, da koro, bosome a ɛtɔ so dummienu a ɛne bosome Adar no da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa no so, na wɔmfom wɔn nnoɔma. 14Atwerɛ no nsususoɔ a wɔde kɔhyɛɛ mmara, nsase no nyinaa soɔ no, hyɛ amanaman no nyinaa, sɛ wɔnsiesie wɔn ho nsie da no. 15Na awɛmfoɔ no firi kɔɔ ntɛmntɛm sɛdeɛ ɔhene kaeɛ no, na wɔhyɛɛ mmara no Susa ahenkuro mu. Na ɔhene no ne Haman tenaa ase sɛ wɔrebɛnom nsa; na Susa kuro no mu ayɛ bisibasaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
